domain: Operations & Market Data Management (Typhoon Alta Equity Platform)
summary: KDD decomposition of Typhoon equity and derivatives instrument setup workflows, including data extraction, autoclose configuration, database registration, and market curve synchronization procedures.

artifacts.title: Typhoon Instrument Setup Subsystem
artifacts.description: System architecture for instrument lifecycle: JBPM ingestion, data extraction, autoclose configuration, Ans registry, Mx3 sync

artifacts.title: Equity Instrument Classification Rules
artifacts.description: Business rules for equity instruments: Murex Label suffix-based pricing category, provider priority (REFINITIV→BLOOMBERG→DATALICENSE)

artifacts.title: Futures & Options Instrument Rules
artifacts.description: Business rules for derivatives: Type-based routing (OPTIONS→archive, FUTURES→setup), BLOOMBERG-only provider, maturity handling

artifacts.title: Data Synchronization Category Taxonomy
artifacts.description: Market curve categories (BASKET/INDEX/EQUITY SMILE/VOLATILITY, REPO_MARGIN) for CLOSE_IPV and IPV_TOTEM synchronization

artifacts.title: Equity Instrument Setup Journey
artifacts.description: Complete user journey: email receipt → JBPM access → data extraction → autoclose config → Ans registration → confirmation

artifacts.title: Futures & Options Setup Journey
artifacts.description: Simplified derivatives journey: type routing (OPTIONS archive, FUTURES setup), autoclose config (BLOOMBERG only), optional sync

artifacts.title: Provider-Rule-Formula Engine for Autoclose
artifacts.description: Functional interface for market data provider config: select provider + rule + formula, test against live data, save

artifacts.title: Mx3 Volatility & Repo Synchronization
artifacts.description: Daily market curve refresh: CLOSE_IPV snapshot, 7 categories, one-at-a-time UI workflow, PROCESSING→timestamp status

artifacts.title: IPV TOTEM Synchronization with Date Range
artifacts.description: Historical month-end data capture: IPV_TOTEM snapshot, Pasta Date parameter, date range filtering, dual Mx3+Ans monitoring

artifacts.title: Equity Setup Standard Operating Procedure
artifacts.description: Step-by-step runbook for equity setup (6 stages): email → JBPM → data extract → autoclose → database → confirmation

artifacts.title: Futures & Options Setup Standard Operating Procedure
artifacts.description: Step-by-step runbook for derivatives: type routing, simplified autoclose (BLOOMBERG), optional sync, error handling

artifacts.title: Synchronization Management Runbook
artifacts.description: Operational guide for market curve sync: daily (CLOSE_IPV) and month-end (IPV_TOTEM) workflows, status polling, troubleshooting

artifacts.title: Instrument Setup Request Triage
artifacts.description: Problem statement and proposed solution: type-based request routing (OPTION/FUTURE/EQUITY) to appropriate handlers

artifacts.title: Equity Instrument Data Extraction
artifacts.description: Atomic task: extract 7 data fields from JBPM (ISIN, Market, Murex Label, Currency, Reference Price, Reuters RIC, Bloomberg ID)

artifacts.title: Autoclose Provider Fallback Logic
artifacts.description: Atomic task: configure autoclose with provider fallback (equities: REFINITIV→BLOOMBERG→DATALICENSE; futures: BLOOMBERG only)
